# Safety

## Context {.flow height=auto}

::: {.card .study-context}
**`r summary$context`**

TEAE = onset on/after first dose, through the cut, in the safety population.
Percentages use the `r summary$metrics$n_safety` first-dosed patients.
Seriousness and severity are independent attributes. These simulated counts
do not support treatment comparisons or clinical recommendations.
:::

## Summary {height=35%}

::: {.card title="Whole study safety summary"}
```{r}
knitr::kable(summary$safety_table, align = c("l", "r"))
```
:::

::: {.card title="Reading these counts"}
`r summary$metrics$n_completed` completed and
`r summary$metrics$n_discontinued` discontinued patients at this cut.
AE discontinuations are a subset of all discontinued patients.
A patient may have multiple events and contribute to multiple AE terms;
term percentages need not sum to 100. Pre-dose events are excluded from TEAE.
The 15 October cut is a **simulated future snapshot** for this demonstration.
:::

## AE terms {height=50%}

```{r}
#| title: "TEAE incidence by term (distinct affected patients)"
plot_terms(summary)
```

::: {.card title="Term incidence / safety population"}
```{r}
if (nrow(summary$terms)) {
  knitr::kable(summary$terms[c("AETERM", "incidence")],
               col.names = c("AE term", "Patients / safety N (%)"))
} else {
  cat("No qualifying TEAEs at this cut.")
}
```
:::
